name: Nicolò Ciccolini
original_name: ニコロ・チッコリーニ
source:
Homecountry: Italy
Likes: Foreign languages
Dislikes: Knives
Favorite things: Japanese food

[url=https://vndb.org/c30792]Hiroki's[/url] classmate who is a foreign exchange student from Italy. Very kind and optimistic, Niccolò came to Japan in order to erase his suspicions of the Japanese culture. Despite being very smart and fluent in 5 languages (Italian, English, German, French and lately Japanese), he is easily fooled into believing wrong things about the Japanese culture.
